lines.text: I sank towards the bottom of the ocean. Unconscious, I was having one of those crazy dreams like the kind you get from eating three bowls of cereal right before going to bed.

The kind of dream where you meet Link, but he’s just some guy who works at a cannabis store, and he’s running around hammering sand dollars while your yassified drunk uncle wolverine starts going off about his hot claws…

Anyways you’re probably wondering why I have a QR code on my head. I’m one of many clones - well there’s not so many of us anymore. The names Forty Forty-Jeffm, and I’m a bit of a rogue, but like in a light fun kinda way: a rogue-lite.
